new: When a parry fails, the character is hit and no block or resist dice are rolled: the defence prevents nothing, and the damage placed in step 5 of the attack sequence equals the full *attack value* (see §9.3, Attack Sequence). Any condition token the attack carries is placed in step 7 of that sequence (see §8.5). A stagger token is then placed on the character, who is staggered (see §8.5, Stagger); the stamina paid for the parry is not returned.
rationale: A failed parry restated the damage and the condition of the attack sequence in the same way; it now points to the steps that resolve them.
